subject: Multi-window availability: interop schedule proposal (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Ahmed <aisha.ahmed@medicareco.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@medicareco.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-window availability: interop schedule proposal (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Really appreciated the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: your team wants predictable, low-latency inference for mixed US/EU/APAC traffic, tenant isolation for PHI-adjacent workloads, and a clear rollout plan for a 3-region pilot. Sounds like a technical deep-dive with engineering (60–75m) is the right next step — we can walk architecture, performance expectations, and the routing/fallback plan.

To make scheduling painless across your team, I sketched a rotating-window approach so each region gets a reasonable local-friendly time at least once/week. Proposal attached: interop-rotation-matrix.xlsx (matrix with three rotating weekly slots) + a quick visual (map-call-lanes.png). High-level options below — pick one recurring band that works for your stakeholders, or tell us constraints and we’ll adapt: 

- Option A (EMEA-friendly primary): Mon 08:00 PDT / Mon 16:00 CET / Tue 00:00 SGT — rotate weekly among three bands
- Option B (US-friendly primary): Tue 10:00 PDT / Tue 19:00 CET / Wed 03:00 SGT — rotate weekly among three bands
- Option C (Split windows): 45m technical + 15m admin; alternate US/EMEA/APAC week-to-week

Next steps I recommend:
1) You confirm which option (A/B/C) or share unavailable times for the next two weeks.
2) We'll send a calendar invite for a 60–75m technical deep-dive and include Priyom (solutions engineer) and Monica (CS lead).

If helpful, we can run a short (20m) timezone alignment call just to lock stakeholders before the deep-dive.

Thanks — I’ll hold a few provisional slots once you confirm preferences.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments referenced: interop-rotation-matrix.xlsx (14KB stub), map-call-lanes.png (28KB stub)

Subject: Re: Multi-window availability: interop schedule proposal (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks, Sergio — great summary.

Tom and I reviewed the three options quickly. Our constraints: engineering leads prefer no meetings before 09:30 PDT and product must be free between 15:00–17:00 CET on demo days. We also want at least one APAC-friendly time slot per month (end of day for EMEA / morning for APAC).

Of your options, Option C looks closest if we can tweak the start time: could we make the technical portion 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CET / 04:00 SGT (45m + 15m) and rotate ownership week-to-week? If that pushes too late for EMEA sometimes, we can run the demo twice (recorded + live Q&A) but prefer a single rotating live slot.

Please propose the next three candidate dates for the deep-dive with that start time. Also add a brief agenda so we can pre-identify questions.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Ahmed

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Aisha. That adjusted cadence (11:00 PDT / 20:00 CET / 04:00 SGT; 45m tech + 15m admin) is doable.

I’ve attached an updated rotation matrix (interop-rotation-matrix.xlsx) and a proposed 3-week pilot schedule. Candidate deep-dive slots (all 75m):
- Wed, 30 May 2028 — 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CET / Thu 04:00 SGT
- Tue, 05 Jun 2028 — 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CET / Wed 04:00 SGT
- Tue, 12 Jun 2028 — 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CET / Wed 04:00 SGT

Proposed agenda (high level):
- 0–15m: Introductions + pilot goals (Monica to set success metrics)
- 15–45m: Architecture deep-dive (Priyom) — routing, KV cache, quantization profile options
- 45–60m: Live perf examples and fallbacks (Sergio/Priyom)
- 60–75m: Rollout plan + Q&A / next steps

If one of the three slots works, I’ll send the invite and include a short prep doc (call objectives and a lightweight checklist for your infra team). If none of these are good, tell me two windows (dates + times) that suit your stakeholders and we’ll pivot.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Sergio
(Account exec)
